sources.entry: LuLu - LuLu is macOS firewall application that aims to block unauthorized (outgoing) network traffic.

summary.one_liner: LuLu is a free, open-source macOS firewall that aims to block unauthorized outgoing network traffic.
summary.what_it_does: The README provided is very short and only introduces LuLu as a free open-source macOS firewall, with translated headers (Simplified and Traditional Chinese) and links to external documentation and a Patreon support page. It does not describe features, architecture, or usage in detail. The one-line description comes from the awesome-list entry under Security, which says LuLu aims to block unauthorized (outgoing) network traffic. Detailed capabilities would need to be checked in the full documentation, which the README links to but does not include.
use_cases: block unauthorized outgoing network traffic on a Mac
monitor which apps make network connections on macOS
add a firewall layer to a macOS machine
open-source alternative to commercial Mac firewalls
notable: Focuses on blocking outgoing network traffic from unauthorized apps
Full documentation hosted externally, linked from the README
caveats: README is nearly empty; no install or usage steps are given in it
Detailed features and setup are only in external documentation
keywords: stop apps connecting to internet mac
